summary: Russian forces have conducted strikes on port infrastructure in the Odessa region, including a cargo ship in the Black Sea. Ukrainian forces are utilizing British-made jet drones, such as the Nyan, for strikes deep into Russian territory. Significant drone activity is reported across multiple fronts, including Sumy, Zaporizhzhya, and Dnipropetrovsk.
key_points: Russian forces struck port infrastructure in the Odessa region, hitting Vilkovo, Belgorod-Dnistrovskyi, and the port of Odessa, including a cargo ship in the Black Sea (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).
Ukraine is using British jet drones, specifically the Nyan from BAE Systems, to strike targets deep in Russia, including Belgorod, Moscow, Yaroslavl, and Volgograd (Source: @UkraineNow/83470).
In the Sumy region, Russian attacks with jet UAVs killed a 75-year-old man and a 72-year-old woman and destroyed two houses (Source: @UkraineNow/83478).
Russian forces have constructed at least 10 military bases along the borders with Ukraine and Belarus designed for mass launches of jet UAVs (Source: @UkraineNow/83477).
The Russian 42nd Guards Motorized Rifle Division confirmed fighting in Orekhov with forward assault groups present in the settlement (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).
Russian forces have liberated the village of Pershomarivka in the DNR (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).
Russian forces have liberated the village of Rybalskoe in the Zaporizhzhya region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).
An explosion occurred in occupied Sevastopol, resulting in the death of a man suspected to be a Ukrainian officer (Source: @UkraineNow/83469).

The largest metallurgical plant in Ukraine, ArcelorMittal Krivoy Rog, has partially suspended production following strikes by the Russian Armed Forces that damaged energy and blast furnace facilities (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32504).
Ukrainian forces have engaged in infantry fighting in Pisarevka, Maryino, Khrapovshchyna, Khoten, and south of Ivolzhansky in the Sumy district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).
The Ukrainian military is facing challenges with mobilization, with the police investigating over 1.5 million requests from the TCC regarding draft evasion (Source: @UkraineNow/83491).
Russian forces attacked the Sumy region with jet UAVs, resulting in the deaths of a 75-year-old man and a 72-year-old woman (Source: @UkraineNow/83478).
Russian forces have constructed at least 10 military bases along the borders with Ukraine and Belarus, featuring at least 59 new mechanical launch rails for UAVs (Source: @UkraineNow/83477).
In the Belgorod region, drone strikes caused multiple injuries, including one person killed in a car attack in the village of Rzhevka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).
Russian forces have engaged in fighting in the Zaporizhzhya region, specifically near the villages of Lunacharskoye and Shevchenko (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).
Russian forces have liberated the village of Pershomarivka in the DNR (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).
Russian forces have liberated the village of Rybalskoe in the Zaporizhzhya region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).
Russian forces have taken control of strongholds west of the Alexandrovka-Kommunarovka line in the Zaporizhzhya region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).

Assault units of the 11th Army Corps of the 'North' group of forces pushed back the 58th motorized infantry brigade and the 475th separate helicopter assault unit from Kudiivka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).
The 'North' group of forces is engaged in fighting in Ulanovo and the area around Volna Sloboda in the Shostkinsky district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).
Russian forces struck port infrastructure in the Odessa region, including Vilkovo, Belgorod-Dnistrovskyi, and the port of Odessa, hitting warehouses and a cargo ship (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515).
A cargo ship flying the flag of the Republic of Togo was struck in the Black Sea during Russian attacks on Odessa's port infrastructure (Source: @UkraineNow/83478).
A Tu-22M3 aircraft was reported in the southern direction, posing a threat of Kh-22 missile launches (Source: @eRadarrua/105715).
Ukrainian forces are using British jet drones, such as the Nyan from BAE Systems, to strike targets deep in Russia (Source: @UkraineNow/83470).
Russian forces are utilizing jet UAVs to attack the Sumy region (Source: @UkraineNow/83478).

sections.threat_assessment: The escalation of long-range drone warfare is evident through the use of British jet drones by Ukraine and Russian jet UAVs against civilian infrastructure in Sumy. The targeting of port infrastructure in Odessa and the Black Sea indicates a sustained effort to disrupt maritime logistics. Additionally, the construction of specialized UAV launch bases along the borders suggests preparations for increased aerial incursions.
sections.regional_response: The Ukrainian government is addressing internal challenges, including corruption concerns in the military-industrial complex and the management of Western aid. In Poland, tensions have risen following reports of physical attacks on Ukrainian minors. Meanwhile, Switzerland has committed $730,000 to preserve Ukrainian cultural heritage, specifically the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra.
sections.intelligence_notes: The use of 'inventory numbers' for foreign mercenaries by Russia is a noted tactic to avoid paying compensation and to classify casualties as 'issing.' The Russian military is also increasing its logistical footprint through the construction of specialized UAV launch facilities. Ukrainian mobilization efforts are facing scrutiny as police investigate potential abuses within the TCC and VLK structures.
